                    [32m'## Uploading an object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`put` function can be used to upload a object to a bucket.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'### `put`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m'put(path: string, body: string | ReadableStream | Blob | Buffer, options?: PutOptions): Promise<TigrisStorageResponse<PutResponse, Error>>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`put` accepts the following parameters:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `path`: (Required) A string specifying the base value of the return URL\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `body`: (Required) A blob object as ReadableStream, String, ArrayBuffer or Blob based on these supported body types\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `options`: (Optional) A JSON object with the following optional parameters:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### `options`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| **Parameter**      | **Required** | **Values**                                                                                                                                              |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| ------------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| access             | No           | The access level for the object. Possible values are `public` and `private`.                                                                            |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| addRandomSuffix    | No           | Whether to add a random suffix to the object name. Default is `false`.                                                                                  |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| allowOverwrite     | No           | Whether to allow overwriting the object. Default is `true`.                                                                                             |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| contentType        | No           | Set the content type of the object. If not provided, the content type will be inferred from the extension of the path.                                  |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| contentDisposition | No           | Set the content disposition of the object. Possible values are `inline` and `attachment`. Default is `inline`. Use `attachment` for downloadable files. |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| multipart          | No           | Pass `multipart: true` when uploading large objects. It will split the object into multiple parts and upload them in parallel.                          |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| partSize           | No           | Part size in bytes for multipart uploads. Default is 5MB.                                                                                               |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| queueSize          | No           | Maximum number of concurrent part uploads for multipart uploads.                                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| abortController    | No           | An AbortController instance to abort the upload.                                                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| onUploadProgress   | No           | Callback to track upload progress: `onUploadProgress({loaded: number, total: number, percentage: number})`.                                             |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| config             | No           | A configuration object to override the [default configuration](#authentication).                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'In case of successful upload, the `data` property will be set to the upload and contains the following properties:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `contentDisposition`: content disposition of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `contentType`: content type of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `modified`: Last modified date of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `path`: Path to the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `size`: Size of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `url`: A presigned URL to the object if the object is uploaded with `access` set to `private`, otherwise unsigned public URL for the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'### Examples\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### Simple upload\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m"const result = await put('simple.txt', 'Hello, World!');\n"[39m +
                    [32m'if (result.error) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m"  console.error('Error uploading object:', result.error);\n"[39m +
                    [32m'} else {\n'[39m +

                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### Uploading a large object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +

                    [32m'## Uploading an object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`put` function can be used to upload a object to a bucket.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'### `put`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m'put(path: string, body: string | ReadableStream | Blob | Buffer, options?: PutOptions): Promise<TigrisStorageResponse<PutResponse, Error>>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`put` accepts the following parameters:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `path`: (Required) A string specifying the base value of the return URL\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `body`: (Required) A blob object as ReadableStream, String, ArrayBuffer or Blob based on these supported body types\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `options`: (Optional) A JSON object with the following optional parameters:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### `options`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| **Parameter**      | **Required** | **Values**                                                                                                                                              |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| ------------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| access             | No           | The access level for the object. Possible values are `public` and `private`.                                                                            |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| addRandomSuffix    | No           | Whether to add a random suffix to the object name. Default is `false`.                                                                                  |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| allowOverwrite     | No           | Whether to allow overwriting the object. Default is `true`.                                                                                             |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| contentType        | No           | Set the content type of the object. If not provided, the content type will be inferred from the extension of the path.                                  |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| contentDisposition | No           | Set the content disposition of the object. Possible values are `inline` and `attachment`. Default is `inline`. Use `attachment` for downloadable files. |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| multipart          | No           | Pass `multipart: true` when uploading large objects. It will split the object into multiple parts and upload them in parallel.                          |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| partSize           | No           | Part size in bytes for multipart uploads. Default is 5MB.                                                                                               |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| queueSize          | No           | Maximum number of concurrent part uploads for multipart uploads.                                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| abortController    | No           | An AbortController instance to abort the upload.                                                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| onUploadProgress   | No           | Callback to track upload progress: `onUploadProgress({loaded: number, total: number, percentage: number})`.                                             |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| config             | No           | A configuration object to override the [default configuration](#authentication).                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'In case of successful upload, the `data` property will be set to the upload and contains the following properties:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `contentDisposition`: content disposition of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `contentType`: content type of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `modified`: Last modified date of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `path`: Path to the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `size`: Size of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `url`: A presigned URL to the object if the object is uploaded with `access` set to `private`, otherwise unsigned public URL for the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'### Examples\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### Simple upload\n'[39m +

                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'## Uploading an object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`put` function can be used to upload a object to a bucket.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'### `put`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m'put(path: string, body: string | ReadableStream | Blob | Buffer, options?: PutOptions): Promise<TigrisStorageResponse<PutResponse, Error>>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`put` accepts the following parameters:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `path`: (Required) A string specifying the base value of the return URL\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `body`: (Required) A blob object as ReadableStream, String, ArrayBuffer or Blob based on these supported body types\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `options`: (Optional) A JSON object with the following optional parameters:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### `options`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| **Parameter**      | **Required** | **Values**                                                                                                                                              |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| ------------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| access             | No           | The access level for the object. Possible values are `public` and `private`.                                                                            |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| addRandomSuffix    | No           | Whether to add a random suffix to the object name. Default is `false`.                                                                                  |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| allowOverwrite     | No           | Whether to allow overwriting the object. Default is `true`.                                                                                             |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| contentType        | No           | Set the content type of the object. If not provided, the content type will be inferred from the extension of the path.                                  |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| contentDisposition | No           | Set the content disposition of the object. Possible values are `inline` and `attachment`. Default is `inline`. Use `attachment` for downloadable files. |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| multipart          | No           | Pass `multipart: true` when uploading large objects. It will split the object into multiple parts and upload them in parallel.                          |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| partSize           | No           | Part size in bytes for multipart uploads. Default is 5MB.                                                                                               |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| queueSize          | No           | Maximum number of concurrent part uploads for multipart uploads.                                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| abortController    | No           | An AbortController instance to abort the upload.                                                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| onUploadProgress   | No           | Callback to track upload progress: `onUploadProgress({loaded: number, total: number, percentage: number})`.                                             |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| config             | No           | A configuration object to override the [default configuration](#authentication).                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'In case of successful upload, the `data` property will be set to the upload and contains the following properties:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `contentDisposition`: content disposition of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `contentType`: content type of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `modified`: Last modified date of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `path`: Path to the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `size`: Size of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `url`: A presigned URL to the object if the object is uploaded with `access` set to `private`, otherwise unsigned public URL for the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'### Examples\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### Simple upload\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m"const result = await put('simple.txt', 'Hello, World!');\n"[39m +
                    [32m'if (result.error) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m"  console.error('Error uploading object:', result.error);\n"[39m +
                    [32m'} else {\n'[39m +
                    [32m"  console.log('Object uploaded successfully:', result.data);\n"[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### Uploading a large object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m"const result = await put('large.mp4', fileStream, {\n"[39m +
                    [32m'  multipart: true,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  onUploadProgress: ({ loaded, total, percentage }) => {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    console.log(`Uploaded ${loaded} of ${total} bytes (${percentage}%)`);\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  },\n'[39m +
                    [32m'});\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### Prevent overwriting\n'[39m +

                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'## Uploading an object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`put` function can be used to upload a object to a bucket.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'### `put`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m'put(path: string, body: string | ReadableStream | Blob | Buffer, options?: PutOptions): Promise<TigrisStorageResponse<PutResponse, Error>>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'`put` accepts the following parameters:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `path`: (Required) A string specifying the base value of the return URL\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `body`: (Required) A blob object as ReadableStream, String, ArrayBuffer or Blob based on these supported body types\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `options`: (Optional) A JSON object with the following optional parameters:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### `options`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| **Parameter**      | **Required** | **Values**                                                                                                                                              |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| ------------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| access             | No           | The access level for the object. Possible values are `public` and `private`.                                                                            |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| addRandomSuffix    | No           | Whether to add a random suffix to the object name. Default is `false`.                                                                                  |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| allowOverwrite     | No           | Whether to allow overwriting the object. Default is `true`.                                                                                             |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| contentType        | No           | Set the content type of the object. If not provided, the content type will be inferred from the extension of the path.                                  |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| contentDisposition | No           | Set the content disposition of the object. Possible values are `inline` and `attachment`. Default is `inline`. Use `attachment` for downloadable files. |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| multipart          | No           | Pass `multipart: true` when uploading large objects. It will split the object into multiple parts and upload them in parallel.                          |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| partSize           | No           | Part size in bytes for multipart uploads. Default is 5MB.                                                                                               |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| queueSize          | No           | Maximum number of concurrent part uploads for multipart uploads.                                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| abortController    | No           | An AbortController instance to abort the upload.                                                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| onUploadProgress   | No           | Callback to track upload progress: `onUploadProgress({loaded: number, total: number, percentage: number})`.                                             |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'| config             | No           | A configuration object to override the [default configuration](#authentication).                                                                        |\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'In case of successful upload, the `data` property will be set to the upload and contains the following properties:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `contentDisposition`: content disposition of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `contentType`: content type of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `modified`: Last modified date of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `path`: Path to the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `size`: Size of the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'- `url`: A presigned URL to the object if the object is uploaded with `access` set to `private`, otherwise unsigned public URL for the object\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'### Examples\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'#### Simple upload\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m"const result = await put('simple.txt', 'Hello, World!');\n"[39m +
                    [32m'if (result.error) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m"  console.error('Error uploading object:', result.error);\n"[39m +
                    [32m'} else {\n'[39m +
                    [32m"  console.log('Object uploaded successfully:', result.data);\n"[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
